how it evolves.

22 people across your team answered seven questions. Today we turn their answers into eight decisions. MV then designs from them and brings the direction back.

Why clients choose Gough, what stays, how far we move, colour across the divisions, the feel, the voice and the photos.

5 How far Gough moves 12.36, 14 minutes

How far should Gough move?

The five steps. 22 people answered.People
  1. 1Tidy upSame look, used properly everywhere.0
  2. 2Tidy up, plus a little polishMost people won't notice. The team will.2
  3. 3A clear refreshRecognisably Gough, visibly sharper.6
  4. 4Fresh, still familiarClients notice something has changed, in a good way.10
  5. 5Noticeably freshPeople can tell something changed.4

14 of 22 chose 4 or 5. Nobody chose a tidy-up only.

The steps are about how visible the change is, word for word as the survey put them. What stays, like the name, the G and navy, was set in section 4 and holds at every step.

7 The feel, as rules 12.58, 12 minutes

Four feelings are nearly settled. One is a real both.

A proposed rule for each settled feeling. Accept it or fix it, about a minute each.

  1. Warm (14 of 22). We write the way we talk to people we know. Never stiff, never formal for the sake of it.
  2. Specialist (12 of 22). Every post shows what we know about property, construction and real estate. Never generic recruitment talk.
  3. Energetic (11 of 22). We show momentum: wins, moves, people going places. Never sleepy.
  4. Personal (10 of 22). Real Gough people with names and faces. Never stock buildings.

PremiumApproachable

413 said both5

  1. When should Gough feel premium, and when approachable?
